whatIsIt.eli5: The rule for nudging the model's numbers, borrowing a trick from big language models.
whatIsIt.simple: An optimizer that combines SGD with Muon. Ultralytics' 'auto' optimizer picks MuSGD for long trainings (more than 10,000 iterations) and AdamW for short ones.
whatIsIt.engineer: Hybrid SGD + Muon (orthogonalised momentum updates); trainer 'auto' → MuSGD(lr 0.01, momentum 0.9) if iterations > 10k.

whyExists.simple: Ultralytics says it stabilises training and converges faster.
